title: Lizard Lighthouse
visualBrief: Twin white octagonal towers with only the eastern tower carrying a diamond-glazed lantern, active optic and weather vane; hooded windows, long two-storey keeper range, projecting gable bays, six tall black chimney stacks, individual rear outshuts, covered engine-room corridor, gabled engine house and semicircular foghorn bay.

sourceFacts.basis: Trinity House publishes19m tower height and identifies the active eastern lantern, twin1752towers and engine house. Historic England listing1328497 describes octagonal towers, hooded windows, projecting end gables, six tall black chimneys, slate roofs and rear service wings. Exact OSM building parts fix tower centers, active diameter, keeper range/outshut and engine-room footprints; remaining vertical dimensions and small detail are photo-proportioned.

geographicProposal.notes: Origin is the mapped active eastern-tower polygon centroid. Native+X runs along the long keeper range east/slightly north; native+Z faces the southern engine room and coast. Exact tower and engine-house parts remove the180degree ambiguity. The western tower is offset[-67.95,0,2.82]m; the source uses ordinary common station-grade contact and does not mistake70m focal elevation for model height.

limitations: Published19m active tower height is distinct from70m focal elevation. Retain exact mapped eastern/western tower centers,68.01m separation,60.53m keeper range and28.54x9.98m engine house. Small fittings, heights and roof/joinery details remain original photograph-proportioned reconstruction controls.

The native origin is the active eastern tower base at ordinary station grade, with western tower offset[-67.95,0,2.82]m. The retained north-up overlay establishes approximate plan orientation and fit; native cliff/site slope, ground clearances and independent coastal buildings remain unverified.

Skyline aggregates repeated glazing, pots and guard decoration and uses opaque lantern glazing with coarse diamond identity; the optic interior and tiny antennas are omitted. District uses complete window-position cards rather than true recesses, simple hoods/sills, pot cards and flat guards. Street restores recesses with fewer optic rings and no tiny finial balls. Closeup keeps coarser round finials, diamond paths and lens rings than the master.

Shared256px materials provide coherent visual scale rather than literal historic stucco/slate scans. Fine prism physics, navigational accuracy, interior access, surveyed garden walls and physical laptop/phone performance remain unverified. Detached hostel, cliffs, external masts and temporary furniture remain map context.
referenceRights: Original geometry and shared procedural materials. Official photographs are research references only; no reference imagery or third-party mesh is embedded or redistributed.

nativeAxes.origin: Authored main tower center at local base level; attached ensembles are offset from this origin.

appearance.identity: Twin white octagonal towers separated by68m, with only the eastern tower carrying its diamond lantern, optic and weather vane; long two-storey keeper range, projecting gable bays, six tall black keeper chimneys, seven rear outshuts and rear wing, covered center passage, engine house and rounded foghorn bay.
appearance.master: Preserve the detailed source and imported master byte-for-byte. Native hill/cliff grading stays separate.
appearance.browser: Four complete source-local levels retain all joined station masses, both octagonal towers, only the eastern active lantern, all eight black chimney stacks including the two engine stacks, rear outshuts, passage, engine/foghorn silhouette and finite site walls. Four existing shared256px graphs supply plaster, slate, painted metal and wood; local dark/clear glazing stays separate. Skyline aggregates repeated windows and chimney pots, omits tiny hardware, optic interior and wall buttresses. District retains every window position as a flat card, hood/green-sill rhythm, diamond glazing, optic and horn, with flat guards and pot cards. Street restores actual facade recesses and deeper hoods, with simpler finials/curves and optic rings. Closeup adds rounded finials, finer diamond paths, curves and joinery; micro rosettes/dome seams aggregate.

geometrySource: Original component-authored exterior mesh using cited dimensional evidence and separately described photo/map reconstructions. No downloaded mesh, texture or reference image is embedded.
sourceLicense: Original geometry under the repository license. Cited sources retain their own rights; OSM-derived axes/footprint evidence © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0.
materialMethod: Shared canonical material graphs with metric UV repeats in extras.molenSurface; portable glTF PBR factors and vertex colors remain. Dark recesses/lantern panels retain local fallback materials.
reviewStatus: Source geometry ready; fallback/shared renders, maximum fidelity and geographic fit require separate review.
